title: Co-founder & CEO
segment: Multi-silicon serverless inference cloud for agentic AI (Gimlet Cloud; runs NVIDIA, AMD, Cerebras, d-Matrix and others)
top_signal: Raised $300M Series B led by a16z at a $3B valuation (6 months after an $80M Series A); funds earmarked for multi-silicon cloud capacity, data-centre pipeline and more serverless/managed offerings
contact_source: Crunchbase person profile + Series B release
why_now: An inference cloud that buys capacity from third parties, with fresh money explicitly for more cloud capacity and a data-centre pipeline. It came out of stealth with eight-figure revenue. Founder-led (CEO is an ex-NVIDIA GPU architect). Blackwell blocks fit the GPU decode/prefill tier of its mixed-chip stack.
cash_flow: Burning but revenue-backed: eight-figure revenue at launch (Mar 2026) plus $300M fresh equity
